original.question_en: Which are the top 10 areas rich in both sections and tables? (high implementation difficulty)
original.cypher: MATCH (sec:Section)-[:CONTAINS_TABLE]->(tbl:TSTable) WITH sec, count(tbl) AS tableCount WHERE tableCount >= 3 MATCH (sec)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp:Spec) OPTIONAL MATCH (sec)-[:HAS_SUB_SECTION]->(sub:Section) RETURN sp.specNumber, sec.sectionNumber, sec.sectionTitle, tableCount, count(sub) AS subSectionCount ORDER BY tableCount DESC LIMIT 10

original.question_en: Rank the main contributors to spec 38.423 (spec-ownership analysis).
original.cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:MODIFIES]->(s:Spec {specNumber: '38.423'}) MATCH (t)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company) RETURN c.companyName, count(DISTINCT t) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC, c.companyName ASC LIMIT 10

original.question_en: Show ZTE's resolution-contribution trend over time (influence trajectory).
original.cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company {companyName: 'ZTE'}) MATCH (r)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN m.canonicalMeetingNumber, m.meetingNumberInt AS mNum, count(DISTINCT r) AS cnt ORDER BY mNum ASC
